attributes.description: INSPECTION IS THURSDAY FROM 9-5:30PM AND FRIDAY MORNING FROM 8:30AM. FULL CATALOGUE WILL BE POSTED AND ALL LOTS WILL HAVE PHOTOS ATTACHED BY 6PM WEDNESDAY. ONLINE ABSENTEE BIDDING WILL CLOSE AT 9:30AM ON FRIDAY MORNING. IF YOU WOULD LIKE TO LEAVE AN ABSENTEE BID AFTER THAT, PLEASE CONTACT THE OFFICE. A 19.8% (INCL GST) BUYERS PREMIUM APPLIES TO THE HAMMER PRICE ON ALL LOTS EXCEPT VEHICLES (CONTACT THE OFFICE) ***IF 2 ABSENTEE BIDS ARE PLACED OF THE SAME AMOUNT, THE FIRST BID PLACED WILL TAKE PRECEDENCE*** WINNING BIDDERS WILL BE EMAILED BY 5PM FRIDAY
